tax.text: Jacobs introduced the LEGACY Act to lower the estate-tax exemption on wealthy families like her own to fund universal child care.
tax.quote: Wealthy families like mine didn't build our wealth alone, and we shouldn't hoard the benefits of success that's not only ours.

housing.text: Jacobs co-introduced legislation to expand transit-oriented housing development, framing the country's problem as a housing shortage.
housing.quote: Our country is facing a severe housing shortage – pushing Americans further away from their work, school, and transit.

abortion.text: Jacobs has repeatedly acted to protect abortion access, including for service members.
abortion.quote: No matter where you live or are stationed, no matter how much money you make, you should have access to abortion.

gender.text: Jacobs was an original co-sponsor of and voted for the Equality Act, which adds gender identity to federal anti-discrimination protections.
gender.quote: As the proud sister to a trans brother and a gender non-conforming sibling, and the proud representative of Hillcrest, the heart of San Diego's LGBTQ+ community, I was honored to vote for the Equality Act.

health.text: Jacobs is an original co-sponsor of Medicare for All legislation.
health.quote: I am proud to be an original co-sponsor of Medicare for All and to join my colleagues in introducing this vitally important legislation today.
